scope: Standalone S31 eFuse read input, XTAL divider update, UART0 clocks/reset and individual HP pad hold. Not a Plus board runtime.
sources: sources.json: fixed ESP-IDF v6.1 fff9895c82d744c7237be8847347bdd1b07c6643 efuse_reg/ll, hp_sys_clkrst_reg, clk_tree_ll, rtc_clk.c, uart_reg/ll, hp_system_reg and lp_system_reg; usb_serial_jtag_reg labels next fault

efuse.readImage: Explicit decoded 79 shadow words,10 error words and block0 valid-bit count; no image is installed by default
efuse.effect: Copies caller input to read-only shadows; READ_DONE raw/status and matrix source152; RTC WDT_DELAY_SEL updated from shadow bit19
efuse.latency: Functional zero-latency transfer; no OTP physical timing or ECC calculation
efuse.conflict: v6.1 WDT_DELAY_SEL is one bit19 even though prose lists four legacy values

clocks.functional: Pending registers become active together at UPDATE; integer/fractional CPU divider and integer MEM/SYS/APB rates derived from XTAL
clocks.unsupported: PLL/RC roots, PLL lock/calibration/power and SYS/APB fractional constraints fail explicitly
clocks.uart: 0x20587088 clock/reset and 0x2058628c memory control gate real FIFO/IRQ; core RX reset and APB modeled-module reset; completed TX capture is retained
clocks.timing: Computed functional rates/baud, not physical serial framing or CPU instruction timing
clocks.headerConflict: Generated PLL_F300M prose superseded by same-version LL mapping mux1=CPLL,mux3=PLL_F240M
